tasks.label: AI Helper: install Claude hooks
tasks.detail: Copies ai-helper/claude-hooks to ~/.claude/hooks/ai-helper and merges settings-hooks.json into ~/.claude/settings.json (backs up what it changes, safe to repeat). Restart Claude sessions afterwards.

tasks.label: AI Helper: check Claude hooks (no changes)
tasks.detail: Reports whether ~/.claude matches ai-helper/claude-hooks. Changes nothing; the task fails (exit 1) when they differ.

tasks.label: AI Helper: install Copilot hooks
tasks.detail: Copies ai-helper/copilot-hooks (plus the shared status script) to ~/.copilot/hooks (backs up what it changes, safe to repeat). Restart Copilot sessions afterwards.

tasks.label: AI Helper: check Copilot hooks (no changes)
tasks.detail: Reports whether ~/.copilot matches ai-helper/copilot-hooks. Changes nothing; the task fails (exit 1) when they differ.
